section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. All data for this comparison were collected at the Riverside Pressure Registry.
